paired_attempt_policy.exact_theorem: The exact group W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q), equivalently W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6};Q)(21), is a direct sum of Q(8); a disproof must exhibit a surviving non-Tate summand in this exact group.

subproblems.exact_theorem: Let T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q). Construct a canonical, atlas-independent CE support-accounting datum (K_Z, T_Z, phi) for the ordered reduced-support evaluation-failure geometry: K_Z must be a named mixed-Hodge term in an explicitly constructed compactification, localization sequence, correspondence, or spectral sequence for M_{6,6}; phi must identify T_Z as a specified subquotient of T with the exact degree, weight, and Tate-twist conventions stated; and an exact filtration, quotient, or spectral-sequence accounting must prove both which part of T is T_Z and that no relevant Z-supported term is omitted. The construction must descend from any presentation/atlas to the same target datum. This theorem makes no Tate assertion and may not assume a closed embedding, Gysin map, support-exhaustion statement, or map to T without proving it.

subproblems.title: Prove Tate type for the canonical CE target subquotient
subproblems.exact_theorem: Let T_Z be the canonical mixed-Hodge subquotient of T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) supplied by a verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE datum. Prove T_Z is a finite direct sum of Q(8). A disproof must exhibit a non-Tate subquotient of this named T_Z through the verified target interface; non-Tate cohomology of an arbitrary family base, atlas, product model, standalone Z, or a source class whose target image is not proved nonzero is not a disproof. This theorem does not itself assemble the complementary target terms.

subproblems.title: Assemble verified canonical target subquotients into the exact target
subproblems.exact_theorem: Using the verified C66-SUPPORT-INTERFACE filtration and the verified Tate type of its T_Z term, prove every named complementary target subquotient is a finite direct sum of Q(8) and that the verified filtration/exact sequence exhausts T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q). Conclude T is a finite direct sum of Q(8).
